queries.query: 1. My Samsung A115G tablet screen flashes and then goes completely blank whenever I tap to open an email in Gmail, and after it works for a short time it goes blank again.

siis_response.title: Email server not responding on Samsung phone or tablet
siis_response.content:
Smartphone,Others Mobile,Mobile Accessories,Tablet Email server not responding on Samsung phone or tablet ( Smartphone,Others Mobile,Mobile Accessories,Tablet): # Troubleshooting Email Connection Issues on Your Samsung Phone
If you're having trouble accessing your email on your Samsung phone, here are some steps you can take to resolve the issue.
## Step 1: Check Email Access on a PC
First, try accessing your email on a personal computer. This helps determine if the problem is with your phone's connection or your email account itself. If you can sign in and access your email on a PC, your phone might not be connected to Wi-Fi or mobile data.
## Step 2: Verify Your Phone's Internet Connection
Ensure your phone is connected to a stable Wi-Fi or mobile data network.
Swipe down from the top of your phone's screen to open the Quick settings panel.
Touch and hold the Wi-Fi icon to check your connection status.
Alternatively, go to Settings, tap Connections, and then tap Wi-Fi. To confirm your internet connection is working, try loading a webpage or performing a quick search.
## Step 3: Review Your Email Account Settings
Sometimes, changes made by your email provider on their server can cause connection problems. In such cases, you may need to remove and re-add your email account to your phone to apply the new configuration.
You can find instructions on how to remove your account and add it again at the provided links.
Before proceeding, make sure you have your email account's username and password readily available.
Remember that passwords are case-sensitive. Entering the password incorrectly will prevent your phone from connecting to your email server.
## Step 4: Clear the Email App's Cache and Data
Clearing the cache and data for your email app can resolve temporary glitches.
To clear the app's cache:
Navigate to Settings.
Tap Apps.
Select your email app.
Tap Storage.
Tap Clear cache.
To clear the app's data:
Navigate to Settings.
Tap Apps.
Select your email app.
Tap Storage.
Tap Clear data, and then tap OK.
Clearing the app's data will reset it to its original settings, effectively wiping it clean.
## Step 5: Restart Your Phone in Safe Mode
Using Safe mode helps identify if a third-party app, including your email app, is causing conflicts with your phone's performance.
Press and hold the Power button or Side button.
If your phone doesn't have a dedicated Power button, swipe down from the top of the screen to open Quick settings, and then tap the Power icon.
Touch and hold the Power off icon.
Tap Safe mode when it appears on the screen.
Your phone will restart, and "Safe mode" will be displayed in the bottom left corner of the screen. While in Safe mode, check if your email app is still experiencing issues. If the problem is resolved, it indicates that another app might be causing the conflict. You can also uninstall the email app if necessary while in Safe mode.
To exit Safe mode, simply restart your phone normally.
## Step 6: Contact Your Email Service Provider
If you have followed all the above steps and are still experiencing difficulties with your email connection, it is recommended to contact your email service provider directly for further assistance.

queries.query: My Galaxy S22 screen turns completely blank or white and no text appears when I search for a stock price or use the Smart Tutor app, and it happens with other apps too.

siis_response.title: Blank or black display on a Samsung phone or tablet
siis_response.content:
Smartphone,Others Mobile,Tablet,Mobile Accessories Blank or black display on a Samsung phone or tablet ( Smartphone,Others Mobile,Tablet,Mobile Accessories): ## Troubleshooting Steps for Device Not Turning On
I understand you're having trouble with your device not turning on. Let's go through some troubleshooting steps together to see if we can resolve this.
### Step 1: Check for Physical Damage and Liquid Exposure
First, please carefully inspect your phone or tablet, charger, and USB cable for any physical damage or signs of liquid exposure.
Please remove any cases or accessories that might be covering the charging port or buttons. Examine the USB connections for any corrosion or bent pins. The USB connection should feel secure with minimal movement. Next, let's check the Liquid Damage Indicator (LDI). The LDI should normally appear solid white, or white with pink or purple X's. Here's how to check the LDI:
Turn off your phone or tablet. Insert the ejector tool into the small hole next to the SIM/MicroSD tray to eject the tray. Shine a flashlight into the SIM/MicroSD slot.
If the device has been exposed to moisture, the LDI will appear solid pink, purple, or red. If this is the case, your device will require service. If the device has not been exposed to moisture, the LDI will be solid white or solid white with pink or purple Xs. Normal LDIs
An LDI exposed to liquid
### Step 2: Force a Restart
If there's no physical or liquid damage, let's try to force a restart on your device. There are two methods for this:
Press and hold both the Power button (or Side button) and the Volume down button simultaneously for at least 20 seconds.
If your device has a removable battery, please remove the battery for 60 seconds, and then reinsert it.
### Step 3: Charge the Device
Now, please connect your phone or tablet to its appropriate charger and let it charge for at least 1 hour. It's important to note that the battery charging indicator might take up to 10 minutes to appear on the display.
### Step 4: Attempt to Power On
After charging, please disconnect the phone or tablet from the charger. Then, try to turn it on by pressing and holding the Power button (or Side button) for 15 to 20 seconds. You should see the Samsung Galaxy logo appear if it powers on successfully.
If the screen turns on, it indicates that your device needed a charge. Please turn off your device and reconnect it to the appropriate charger until it is fully charged. If the screen still fails to turn on after completing all these steps, your device may require service. In this case, please contact the Samsung Support Center for further assistance.

queries.query: My Galaxy tablet screen stays completely blank when I try to use Smart Switch to scan the QR code for transferring data from my Galaxy S25 phone, so the transfer can't proceed.

siis_response.title: Transfer Secure folder with Smart Switch
siis_response.content:
Mobile Accessories,Smartphone,Tablet,Others Mobile Transfer Secure folder with Smart Switch ( Mobile Accessories,Smartphone,Tablet,Others Mobile): ## Data Transfer Using Smart Switch
### 1. Connection Method
Wireless connection: If you are using a wireless transfer, place the devices within 4 inches of each other.
Wired connection: If you are using a wired transfer, plug one end of the USB cable into the charging port of the new phone and connect the other end to the charging port of the old phone.
### 2. Open Smart Switch App
Swipe up on the Home screen to access the Apps screen. Tap the Search field, then enter and select Smart Switch to open the app. Alternatively, you can navigate to the Samsung folder on the Apps screen and open Smart Switch from there.
Next, on the new device, tap Receive on this phone. Then, on the old device, tap Send from this phone
### 3. Select Transfer Method
Wireless transfer: On the new device, tap Galaxy/Android, then tap Wireless transfer. A QR code will be displayed. Next, on the old device, tap Wireless data transfer, then scan QR code displayed on new phone.
